page.overview:
Who is Lelaine Akashi?

Lelaine Akashi is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She is currently First Selector of the Blue and one of its Sitters in the Hall of the Tower.

Lelaine is tall, slender and quite pretty, with a warm smile that transforms her face, although she does not smile often. She is dignified, has dark penetrating almond shaped eyes, and full lips. Despite her age her hair has not sign of gray.

Lelaine is has a strength level of in the One Power, putting her at the very top tier of Aes Sedai in terms of strength. She was one of only four women mentioned by Cadsuane Melaidhrin in New Spring as being the on par with Moiraine Damodred, and Cadsuane predicted that these five would be at the top of the hierarchy once she, Kerene Nagashi and Meilyn Arganya were dead. Within a year of this prediction, Lelaine would have been the strongest Aes Sedai in the Tower.

Due to a number of deaths between New Spring and the end of A Memory of Light, she is now the fourth strongest living Aes Sedai, behind Nynaeve al'Meara, Elayne Trakand and Cadsuane Melaidhrin with a large gap between herself and Cadsuane.
